Suspension Order

Date: {{ frappe.utils.format_date(frappe.utils.nowdate(), "dd-MMM-yyyy") }}

Employee Name: {{ doc.employee_name }}

Employee ID: {{ doc.employee_id }}

Designation: {{ doc.designation }}

Branch Name: {{ doc.branch_name }}

We understand that there is a serious allegation regarding {{ doc.case_type }} made against you. It has been identified to us that {{ doc.issue_in_detail }}.

Since the allegation happens to be of a serious nature and amounts to gross misconduct within the meaning of the policy and procedures of the Company applicable to you, in view of the above, you are hereby suspended from duty with immediate effect i.e. {{ frappe.utils.format_date(doc.suspension_from_date, "dd-MMM-yyyy") }}, pending enquiry (as per Company's policy). You are hereby advised immediately to surrender all files / documents / computers etc. to your reporting authority.

For the above-mentioned period of suspension, you will be entitled to subsistence allowance if you are not found guilty, subject to your producing a written declaration that you were not engaged in any other employment, business, profession, or vocation during the above suspension period. A show cause notice will follow in this regard.

For Sahayog Multistate Credit Cooperative Society

Authorized Signatory
